description: Remove an installed plugin by its installationId (from list_gameserver_plugins with installedOnly=true). Deletes the plugin jar; its config folder stays. The server must be stopped. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: uninstall_gameserver_plugin
title: Remove Game Server Plugin
